name: Roamlight
description: Your family's photo album, on your own server, for your own people. Point Roamlight at the share where your photographs already live. It makes a web copy of each one, reads the date, the camera and the place out of the file, sorts everything into albums and puts the albums on a map. You decide, album by album, who in the family may see it, and nothing leaves the house unless you hand somebody a share link with a password and an end date. It understands JPEG, HEIC, RAW (CR3, ARW, NEF, DNG and more) and phone videos, never writes into your originals, and plays albums as a slideshow. Sign in with passwords or with your own single sign-on (Authentik, Keycloak and other OpenID Connect providers). There is a free iPhone app on the App Store, and an Android app that your own Roamlight hands out. Install it, open the web page and create the administrator account. To connect a phone, open "Phone & tablet" on the site.

paths.name: Photos
paths.description: Your photographs, as they came off the camera. Read, and never changed; new uploads are added here.

paths.name: Library
paths.description: The web copies Roamlight makes: one JPEG per photograph, in the same folders. They can be rebuilt from the photographs, but that takes a while.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: The database (albums, who sees what, accounts) and the smaller web sizes. Back this folder up.

variables.name: Site address
variables.description: The address people type to reach Roamlight: http://your-server-ip:8080 at home, or https://photos.example.com behind a reverse proxy. Share links and the phone apps use it.

variables.name: Site title
variables.description: The name at the top of every page and on the home screen.

variables.name: Setup token
variables.description: Optional. A word of your own: the first-start page then only opens with ?t=that-word. Recommended if other people are on your network. Can be removed once the administrator account exists.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user the files are written as. 99 is Unraid's 'nobody'.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group the files are written as. 100 is Unraid's 'users'.

variables.name: Sign-in
variables.description: local (passwords), oidc (your own single sign-on) or local+oidc (both). Single sign-on can also be set up later on the Settings page.

variables.name: Trusted proxies
variables.description: If a reverse proxy (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager, Traefik...) is in front: its IP address, so the sign-in throttle can tell visitors apart.

variables.name: Home
variables.description: Where your journeys start when an album has no departure of its own (the name shown on the map).

variables.name: Home latitude
variables.description: Latitude of your home, for the journey map.

variables.name: Home longitude
variables.description: Longitude of your home, for the journey map.

variables.name: Conversions at once
variables.description: How many photographs are converted at the same time. Each takes about three quarters of a CPU core.
